description: Select or deselect keyframes of a property in the Timeline panel, or deselect every keyframe, property and property group (Edit > Deselect All in the Timeline). Selected keyframes are what run_animation_command's keyframe commands act on

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

deselectAll.description: First deselect every keyframe, property and property group on the layers

keys.description: Which keyframes of the property: those matching any of indexes, the from/to time range, times or selected. Omit for all of them

from.description: Keyframes at or after this time (seconds)

selected.description: The keyframes selected in the Timeline panel

to.description: Keyframes at or before this time (seconds)

layers.description: Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true. With deselectAll and no layers, every layer

mode.description: replace (default): only these keyframes of the property are selected; add; remove

property.description: A property: a shortcut (anchor_point, position, scale, rotation, opacity, x_rotation, y_rotation, orientation, source_text, time_remap, audio_levels) or a path of match names or display names from the layer, e.g. ["ADBE Effect Parade", "Gaussian Blur", "Blurriness"]. Omit to only deselect

name: select_keyframes
title: Select Keyframes
